{{Infobox
| italic title = {{{italic title|}}}
| bodyclass = vcard
| bodystyle = {{#if:{{{infoboxwidth|{{{width|}}}}}}|width:{{{infoboxwidth|{{{width}}}}}}}}
| titlestyle = font-style:italic;
| title = <includeonly>{{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}} <span class="Z3988" title="ctx_ver=Z39.88-2004&rft_val_fmt={{urlencode:info:ofi/fmt:kev:mtx:book}}&rft.genre=book&rft.btitle={{urlencode:{{{name|}}}}}{{#if:{{{author|}}}|&rft.author={{urlencode:{{{author}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{last|}}}|&rft.aulast={{urlencode:{{{last}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{first|}}}|&rft.aufirst={{urlencode:{{{first}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{pub_date|{{{release_date|}}}}}}|&rft.date={{urlencode:{{{pub_date|{{{release_date}}}}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{publisher|}}}|&rft.pub={{urlencode:{{{publisher}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{location|}}}|&rft.place={{urlencode:{{{location}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{pages|}}}|&rft.pages={{urlencode:{{{pages}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{series|}}}|&rft.series={{urlencode:{{{series}}}}}}}{{#if:{{{oclc|}}}|&rft_id=info:oclcnum/{{{oclc}}}}}"></span></includeonly>
| image   = {{#if:{{{image|}}}|{{#ifeq:{{Str left|{{{image|}}}|1}}|[|[[Category:Infobox book image param needs updating]]}}{{#invoke:InfoboxImage|InfoboxImage |image={{{image|}}}|size={{{image_size|}}}|sizedefault=frameless|upright=1|alt={{{alt|}}}|border={{{border|}}}|suppressplaceholder=yes}}|{{#ifeq:{{Yesno|{{lc:{{{exclude_cover|no}}}}}}}|yes||{{Main other|[[Category:Books with missing cover]]}}}}}}
| caption = {{{caption|{{{image_caption|}}}}}}

| label1  = Editor{{#if:{{{editors|}}}|s}}
| data1   = {{{editors|{{{editor|}}}}}}
| label2  = Author{{#if:{{{authors|}}}|s}}
| data2   = {{{authors|{{{author|}}}}}}
| label3  = Original&nbsp;title
| data3   = {{#if:{{{title_orig|}}}|{{Lang|{{{orig_lang_code|}}}|''{{{title_orig}}}''}}}}

| label4  = Working&nbsp;title
| data4   = {{#if:{{{title_working|}}}|''{{{title_working}}}''}}
| label5  = Translator{{#if:{{{translators|}}}|s}}
| data5   = {{{translators|{{{translator|}}}}}}
| label6  = Illustrator{{#if:{{{illustrators|}}}|s}}
| data6   = {{{illustrators|{{{illustrator|}}}}}}

| label7  = Cover&nbsp;artist
| data7   = {{{cover_artist|}}}
| label8  = Country
| data8   = {{{country|}}}
| label9  = Language
| data9   = {{{language|}}}

| label10 = Series
| data10  = {{{series|}}}
| label11 = Subject{{#if:{{{subjects|}}}|s}}
| data11  = {{{subjects|{{{subject|}}}}}}
| label12 = Genre{{#if:{{{genres|}}}|s}}
| data12  = {{{genres|{{{genre|}}}}}}

| label13 = Published
| data13  = {{{published|}}}
| label14 = Publisher
| data14  = {{{publisher|}}}{{#if:{{{publisher2|}}}|, {{{publisher2}}}}}
| label15 = {{Longitem|Publication date}}
| data15  = {{{pub_date|{{{release_date|}}}}}}

| label16 = {{Longitem|Published&nbsp;in English}}
| data16  = {{{english_pub_date|{{{english_release_date|}}}}}}
| label17 = Media&nbsp;type
| data17  = {{{media_type|}}}
| label18 = Pages
| data18  = {{{pages|}}}

| label19 = Award{{#if:{{{awards|}}}|s}}
| data19  = {{{awards|{{{award|}}}}}}
| label20 = [[International Standard Book Number|ISBN]]
| data20  = {{#if:{{{isbn|{{{ISBN|}}}}}}|{{#iferror:{{#expr:{{{isbn|{{{ISBN}}}}}}}}|{{{isbn|{{{ISBN}}}}}}|[[Special:Booksources/{{{isbn|{{{ISBN}}}}}}|{{{isbn|{{{ISBN}}}}}}]]}}}}
| label21 = [[OCLC#Control Numbers|{{Abbr|OCLC|Online Computer Library Center number}}]]
| data21  = {{#if:{{{oclc|}}}|[//www.worldcat.org/oclc/{{urlencode:{{{oclc}}}}} {{{oclc}}}]}}

| label22 = {{longitem|[[Dewey Decimal Classification|Dewey Decimal]]}}
| data22  = {{{dewey|}}}
| label23 = [[Library of Congress Classification|{{Abbr|LC&nbsp;Class|Library of Congress Classification}}]]
| data23  = {{{congress|}}}
| label24 = Preceded&nbsp;by
| data24  = {{#if:{{{preceded_by|}}}|''{{{preceded_by|}}}'' |{{#if:{{{preceded_by_quotation_marks|}}}|"{{{preceded_by_quotation_marks|}}}"}} }}

| label25 = Followed&nbsp;by
| data25  = {{#if:{{{followed_by|}}}|''{{{followed_by|}}}'' |{{#if:{{{followed_by_quotation_marks|}}}|"{{{followed_by_quotation_marks|}}}"}} }}
| label26 = {{longitem|Original text}}
| data26  = {{#if:{{{native_wikisource|}}}|''{{Lang|{{{orig_lang_code|}}}|[[s:{{#if:{{{orig_lang_code|}}}|{{{orig_lang_code|}}}:}}{{{native_wikisource|}}}|{{{title_orig|{{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}}}}]]}}'' at {{#ifeq:{{#language:{{{orig_lang_code}}}}}|{{{orig_lang_code}}}||{{Iso2lang|{{{orig_lang_code}}}}}}} [[Wikisource]]{{Main other|[[Category:Articles that link to foreign-language Wikisources]]}}<!--create hidden category to be monitored by Wikiproject:Wikisource-->|{{#if:{{{native_external_url|}}}|''{{Lang|{{{orig_lang_code|}}}|[{{{native_external_url|}}} {{{title_orig|{{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}}}}]}}'' {{#if:{{{native_external_host|}}}|at {{{native_external_host|}}}|online}}}}}}
| label27 = {{#if:{{{native_wikisource|}}}|Translation |{{#if:{{{native_external_url|}}}|Translation|Text}} }}
| data27  = {{#if:{{{wikisource|}}}|''[[s:{{{wikisource|}}}|{{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}]]'' at {{#if:{{{native_wikisource|}}}|Wikisource|[[Wikisource]]}}{{Main other|[[Category:Articles that link to Wikisource]]}}<!--create hidden category to be monitored by Wikiproject:Wikisource-->|{{#if:{{{external_url|}}}|''[{{{external_url|}}} {{{name|{{PAGENAME}}}}}]'' {{#if:{{{external_host|}}}|at {{{external_host|}}}|online}}}}}}
| belowstyle = font-size:smaller; border-top:#aaa 1px solid;
| below = {{{notes|{{{note|}}}}}}
